definition: Median corrected stationary-landmark residual on held-out BIRDSAI TestReal after ego-motion correction.
role: Primary central empirical geometric residual reference.
allowed_use: Compare pixel-space forecast error magnitude against the typical post-correction residual scale on the same held-out BIRDSAI domain.
not_allowed: Do not call this a universal irreducible annotation-noise floor; do not directly transfer it to WildBox/BAMBI without separate validation.

definition: 95th-percentile corrected stationary-landmark residual on held-out BIRDSAI TestReal after ego-motion correction.
allowed_use: Quantify what fraction of pixel-space forecast errors lie above a high residual envelope on held-out BIRDSAI TestReal.
not_allowed: Do not use as a tuned forecasting threshold; do not infer field measurement uncertainty outside the validated BIRDSAI correction setting.
